title: nora-patel devx SDK TODO / daily scratchpad 2026-03-10
content:
Quick notes (morning, 2026-03-10)

High level: follow-ups from last week + prep for docs sync with product on Thursday. Focus on 1) sample app parity with hosted API changes (streaming / tool-calls), 2) a short tutorial fix for new auth flow, 3) doc gaps around batching/quantization guidance.

TODAY PRIORITIES
1) Sample app: web-chat (React)
   - Problem: streaming example in README doesn't match new streaming responses shape (now returns event 'token' objects instead of raw chunks). Causes the sample to hang until end-of-stream.
   - Quick fix: update sample to use the event parser in streaming-utils.js and show incremental tokens to UI.
   - Done: created PR with minimal patch to example (local) but need review / CI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/pull/342 (Alex to review).
   - Next: add a test that simulates server-sent events for streaming to catch regressions. Owner: Nora. ETA: 2026-03-12.

2) Tutorial: "first app with Redwood API" (docs site)
   - Gap: auth flow changed (bearer token -> short-lived session token + client-config). Current tutorial shows long-lived token copied into env. Need to:
     a) add step for creating ephemeral key via dashboard + how to set it in local .env
     b) update code sample to use client.tokenManager.getToken() helper so users don't hardcode tokens.
   - Action: draft PR for docs (markdown) with code snippets. Nora to draft; Samantha to proof. ETA: 2026-03-11.

3) Batching & quantization guide (Optimize page)
   - Observed confusion: customers trying naive batching with short prompt latencies see worse p99. Need a short decision tree in docs: when to batch, when to use prefix caching, recommended batch sizes per model family and target latency.
   - Collect data: ask infra for perf profiles (5/10/20 tokens) for xformers quantized L4 on A100. Linked ticket: JIRA-DEVX-789.
   - Draft outline in Confluence: CONFLUENCE-DEVX-112.

Backlog / lower priority
- Add missing TypeScript types in SDK v1.2.0 (breaking change notes) — file an issue to track.
- Add a small golang sample app for embeddings (ops asked for quick snippet).

Blockers / questions
- Need final streaming response contract from serving runtime team (SRE/serving-runtime). I pinged Jordan Park; awaiting reply. If contract stable, merge sample fix.
- On the ephemeral token UX: product wants to hide client.tokenManager helper behind beta flag until next week; may need to keep tutorial showing both approaches. Decision by EOD Wednesday.

Notes to self (todo list)
- [ ] Finish streaming test harness (node) — create helper to mock SSE. (Nora)
- [ ] Open issue for TS types gap and link PR template. (Nora)
- [ ] Draft tutorial PR and add code snippet for tokenManager usage. (Nora + Samantha)
- [ ] Sync with Alex on sample app PR comments. (Today)
- [ ] Ask infra for perf numbers for quant profiles (cc: infra@redwood).

Quick snippets to paste into PRs / docs:
- streaming parser (pseudo):
  const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw-large', messages });
  for await (const event of stream) {
    if (event.type === 'token') appendToken(event.token);
  }

- tokenManager usage (js):
  const client = new RedwoodClient({ baseUrl: process.env.RW_API_URL });
  const sessionToken = await client.tokenManager.getToken();
  client.setAuth(sessionToken);

Meetings today
- 10:30 sync with Samantha (docs review)
- 14:00 infra quick sync (perf numbers)
- 16:00 cross-functional triage with product (streaming contract)

Random notes / brain dump
- Consider a "migration" guide page listing SDK changes per release (like breaking changes + recommended quick fixes). Could reduce support churn.
- Add a small checklist template for sample apps so we ensure parity across languages (js/py/go).

End of note.
